'''Dr. Moss''' (Japanese: '''ドクター・マスダ''' ''Dr. Masuda'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG060|Delcatty Got Your Tongue]]''. He was seen only in flashbacks and didn't have a speaking role. He is a [[Doctor (Trainer class)|Pokémon Doctor]].

Dr. Moss was [[Dr. Abby]]'s teacher in the techniques of massage therapy for Pokémon, much like {{wp|shiatsu}}. He gave Dr. Abby the [[Moon Stone]] that [[Evolution|evolved]] her {{p|Skitty}} into a {{p|Delcatty}}, teaching her that Abby had to "evolve" herself much like Johnny had.
